objective: Add a test proving that a sold item leaves the player's bag.
criteria: a test fails if selling stops removing the item
context: ShopService.sell(bag, item_id) returns a SaleResult and must remove the item from bag.
diff:
--- a/tests/unit/test_shop_sell.gd
+++ b/tests/unit/test_shop_sell.gd
@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+extends TestCase
+
+func test_selling_removes_the_item() -> void:
+	var bag := Bag.new()
+	bag.add(&"herb_lingzhi", 1)
+	var shop := ShopService.new()
+	var result := shop.sell(bag, &"herb_lingzhi")
+	# the sale went through
+	assert_true(result != null, "sell returned a result")
+	assert_true(true, "item removed")
